new_findings.finding: The server error ratio and A2AServerErrorRatioHigh count every JSON-RPC error code, including caller mistakes (-32001 TaskNotFound, -32602 invalid params, -32601 method not found, version not supported), because the JSON-RPC conventions make every code an error; the same traffic over HTTP+JSON (404) or gRPC (NOT_FOUND) is not counted. The instrumentation follows semconv; the alert built on it pages on binding choice.
new_findings.scenario: A client polls GetTask for tasks the reaper or retention removed, or a buggy client sends bad params, over JSON-RPC: 5% of calls for 10 minutes pages the on-call although the server is healthy. book walkthrough.md:102-104 shows exactly this firing from deliberate task-not-found traffic.

new_findings.finding: logs.md says spans are not filtered by level and that with install_subscriber 'every span is exported'; since the C-01 fix spans below TelemetryBuilder::with_span_level (default INFO, telemetry/mod.rs:191-205) are not exported, and with_span_level appears nowhere in the book (rg). walkthrough.md says Prometheus 'lists the eight alerts'; a2a-alerts.yml has nine (A2AAgentInstancesLost added with C-04).
new_findings.scenario: An operator who needs DEBUG spans for an incident reads the book, does not find with_span_level, and concludes they are already exported.

new_findings.finding: Values the upstream crates warn about and ignore (an invalid OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TEMPORALITY_PREFERENCE, an unknown OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER) are reported through otel_warn! while Telemetry::build constructs the exporters, before install_subscriber has installed any subscriber, so the warning is dropped. environment.md:13-16 admits this for the sampler only.
new_findings.scenario: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TEMPORALITY_PREFERENCE=Delta-typo or OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=traceidratio-typo: the setting is silently replaced by the default and nothing is printed.

new_findings.finding: The 64 KiB content budget is charged only for text, URIs and data: mime_type and filename are not charged (:363, :370-371), every part still adds a JSON object after the budget is spent (take() returns a marker per part), and OutputRecorder extends its Vec for every output event until the turn ends. Neither the attribute nor the memory held is bounded by CONTENT_LIMIT.
new_findings.scenario: With with_span_content_capture(true), an agent streaming 100k append ArtifactUpdate chunks holds 100k serde_json Values for the turn and records a multi-MB gen_ai.output.messages; over OTLP/gRPC that can exceed the Collector's 4 MiB default receive size and lose the whole batch (conjecture). Opt-in only.

new_findings.finding: OTEL_SDK_DISABLED accepts only case-insensitive 'true'; '1', 'yes' or 'on' are silently false. The spec's boolean rule says any value other than true, false or empty SHOULD log a warning; none is pushed to notices.
new_findings.scenario: An operator sets OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=1 to rule telemetry out during an incident; export continues and nothing says the variable was not understood.
